practice_questions.question_text: Evaluate using an ML language system as the sole assessor of student essays.
practice_questions.adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
practice_questions.solution: It can provide rapid, consistent preliminary scoring across many submissions. However, training bias may disadvantage language varieties and an opaque score can be difficult to challenge; nuanced reasoning may be missed. Human moderation, transparent criteria and testing across student groups are needed, so sole automated assessment is not justified merely by speed.

practice_questions.question_text: Explain why a browser and server must follow the same HTTP communication rules, and how HTTPS adds protection.
practice_questions.adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
practice_questions.solution: Shared HTTP message/request-response rules let each side interpret messages correctly. HTTPS protects that exchange with TLS, providing confidentiality/integrity and server authentication through certificates.
